actions.reactMessage.description: Add an emoji reaction to a specific message as a chosen user.
actions.reactMessage.props.description.d: This action allows you to add an emoji reaction to a message in any accessible channel on behalf of a specific user. The reaction will appear as if the selected user added it directly to the message.
actions.reactMessage.props.messageId.des: The ID of the message to react to
actions.reactMessage.props.user.descript: The user account that will add the reaction
actions.replyMessage.description: Reply to a specific message as a chosen user in a channel.
actions.replyMessage.props.description.d: This action allows you to reply to a message in any accessible channel on behalf of a specific user. The reply will appear as if the selected user posted it directly in response to the original message.
actions.replyMessage.props.message.descr: The content of the reply to be posted.
actions.replyMessage.props.messageId.des: The ID of the message to reply to.
actions.replyMessage.props.user.descript: The user account that will send the message
actions.sendMessage.description: Posts a message to a specified channel as a chosen user
actions.sendMessage.props.channel.descri: The channel where the message will be posted
actions.sendMessage.props.description.de: This action allows you to send messages to any accessible channel as a specific user. The message will appear as if the selected user posted it directly.
Additional fields based on channel type
actions.sendMessage.props.images.descrip: Add one image URL per entry (e.g., https://example.com/image1.png)
actions.sendMessage.props.message.descri: The message to be posted (optional if images are provided)
actions.sendMessage.props.user.descripti: The user account that will send the message
